answer: Sybil resistance is stake-and-slash identity: an agent earns one vote only after locking a bond and getting attestations from unrelated bonded agents. A clone is a hollow shell until it posts its own bond and finds fresh attestors, so k fake identities need k separate deposits, and proven double-voting burns all of them. Rewards are capped per identity while deposits are not, so growing from a lone dune of copies to an army painted saffron multiplies the attacker's cost faster than any payoff; the fraud stays unprofitable.
